meta.description: Rubén Ruzafa — Personal trainer and triathlon coach. Former XTERRA & ITU World Champion. Online and in-person training.

now.title: Who I am today
paragraphs: After a long career as an elite athlete, I now dedicate myself fully to personal training and supporting athletes of all levels.

I hold a Bachelor's degree in Physical Activity and Sports Sciences and am a Level 2 triathlon coach. I combine over two decades of top-level competition with academic training to design personalized plans.
My goal is to help you reach your targets: improve performance, prepare for a race, or train smarter.

career.title: Sporting career
paragraphs: Competing in mountain bike from age 12, I rode for the BH-Sierra Nevada and the Orbea Racing Team. In 2008 I became XTERRA World Champion in Maui. From 2013 I specialized in cross triathlon and XTERRA, winning world and European titles until retiring from professional competition.
Today I channel all that experience into coaching, helping others perform at their best with the same rigor I applied to my own career.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
sections: Rubén Ruzafa is committed to protecting and respecting your privacy. This policy describes how we collect, use, and share personally identifiable information through our website www.rubenruzafa.com and www.rubenruzafa.es.
We collect personally identifiable information when you complete contact forms or interact with our site. Information may include full name and email address.
We use the information to respond to your inquiries, improve our services, and comply with applicable legal obligations.
We do not sell or share your personal information with unaffiliated third parties, except as described in this policy or with your express consent.
We implement reasonable security measures to protect personal information. However, no Internet transmission is completely secure.
You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal information. To exercise these rights, contact us through the contact form.
We may update this policy periodically. We recommend reviewing this page regularly.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
sections: We use cookies and similar technologies to improve your experience on our website. By continuing to browse, you accept their use.
A cookie is a small text file stored on your device. We use cookies to remember preferences such as language and dark mode.
You can configure your browser to reject cookies, although some site features may not work correctly.
By using our website, you accept the use of cookies in accordance with this policy.
